chunks: Fadalah from 'Umar ibn Aban who said: I heard a righteous servant say
regarding the inmates of Hell: that they enter the Fire due to their sins, and they come out through the pardon of Allah
ai.seo_question: How do the inhabitants of Hell get out according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd* highlights the Shia doctrine of *Khuruj Ahl al-Nar min al-Nar* (the exit of the people of Hell from the Fire), emphasizing that entry is a consequence of justice for sins, while exit is a gift of divine mercy. It underscores the balance between Allah’s justice and His vast pardon, a key theme in Shia eschatology regarding the eventual purification of believers who committed major sins.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 4.Faḍālah narrated from ʿUmar ibn Abān who said, “I heard a righteous servant (ʿAbd Ṣāliḥ)[1] say
regarding the inmates of Hell [who are released after their punishment], ‘They are made to enter the Fire due to their sins, and they come out therefrom through the pardon of Allah.’”
